name: list_skill
description: 列出所有可用的 skill（渐进式披露第一级：仅 name + description，消耗极少 token）。先用本工具发现可用技能，再用 use_skill 激活。
description_en: List all available skills (progressive disclosure level 1: name + description only, minimal token cost). Use this tool to discover available skills, then use_skill to activate one.
